svg.aria-label: An ASCII knight kneeling in a field of poppies, rendered live next to the code that draws it
svg.title: reel2ascii.py

text.tspan: """reel2ascii - fold every frame of the reel into one still, then into glyphs.
Brightness picks the character, colour picks the ink.
# one glyph, measured off the frames
# where the first glyph cell starts
# the art region of a 720x1280 frame
# where the poppies begin (fraction of art)
"""median of all frames: the drips and noise fall away, the knight stays"""
"""sample the still exactly on the reel's glyph grid: one colour per glyph"""
# the knight: bright, grey, and standing in the middle of the frame
"""keep only the biggest connected shape (8-neighbour flood fill)"""
# lift thin glyphs to the pixel's tone
"""lone bright specks in the night sky get lifted out to twinkle"""
